prompt_head:
Role: Configuration Specialist II at CentralReach
<requirements>
[r1] (required, years_experience) 1–3 years of experience in a technical configuration, impleme

assessments.note: About 4 years of technical experience, including ops CRM and client onboarding work at Linkme.
Shows client onboarding and error-reducing validation pipelines, but no explicit concurrent task management.
Shows client-facing onboarding work, but no explicit cross-functional work with Implementation, Product, or Engineering teams.
Shows debugging and pipeline work, but no explicit resolution of complex configuration issues with limited guidance.
Builds backend pipelines and AI agent workflows, but not translation of documented requirements into configurations.
Onboards clients and built an ops CRM module, but no explicit account provisioning across internal systems.
Git and project management support version tracking, but no config documentation or change logs shown.
Based in South Florida near Ft. Lauderdale; hybrid willingness is not stated.

output.verdict_line: The candidate has about four years of relevant technical and onboarding experience but lacks direct evidence for several configuration-specific duties.
top_gaps: Manage multiple configuration tasks concurrently with attention to detail
Provision and configure customer accounts across internal systems with minimal oversight
Maintain accurate configuration documentation and change logs
